allowed_domains.description: The email domains it accepts, an account's verified email on one of them; empty: any.

items.description: An email domain, lower case: the part of an address after the @.

changed_at.description: When its switches last changed; absent until they first do.

enabled.description: Whether it signs people in; turned off, new sign-ins through it are refused.

last_for_super_admin.description: true when a Super admin signs in with it alone: turning it off, or narrowing its domains past their email, is refused.

name.description: Its name on the sign-in page.

pending.description: A change of its switches waiting for the other Super admin, if any.

provider.description: The provider's ID in the deployment's configuration.

sign_ins.description: Sessions it started in the last 30 days.

version.description: Its switches' version, for If-Match: 0 until a Super admin first changes them.
